name: oak-desktop-cloud
description: Run OAK MCP locally and search your private cloud stores. No local database or Docker required.

store_id.title: Store ID
store_id.description: Optional single-store UUID. Keep an existing setting, or configure Stores below.

personal_key.title: Personal key
personal_key.description: Create a named connection key for this store in OAK. Enter it only here, never in chat. Claude stores this sensitive setting securely.

allow_changes.title: Allow memory changes
allow_changes.description: Off by default. Turn on only to permit creating, editing, merging, deleting and policy changes in configured stores. Server roles, credits and Claude approvals still apply. Autosave stays off.

stores.title: Stores (JSON)
stores.description: Optional list of cloud stores: [{"name":"Personal","storeId":"STORE_UUID","personalKey":"STORE_KEY"}]. Use each store’s own key. Existing Store ID and Personal key may stay configured; do not repeat that store here. Enter keys only in these settings, never in chat.
